Orange Volume (cm3) line follows the same shape below the blue line, falls steeply to about tick 4, stays low from tick 5 and lies on the zero line toward the right side.
Blue arrow labeled NPWT points to tick 4; arrow labeled felt points to tick 7; arrows from the label bi-layered skin equavalent point to tick 8 and tick 12.
Gray gridlines on the untitled left axis; x tick labels initial visit, Week 1 and 2 to 16; legend entries Area (cm2) and Volume (cm3).
